transcript.note: Whole-grid assignment, not a nudge of the rank-snapping control. Two design rules. (1) orderFlip guard by construction: col is a weakly monotone function of gx and row a weakly monotone function of gy, so no unambiguous E/W or N/S pair can invert. Ties are free, which is the entire budget I spend on straightness. (2) H/V comes only from merging *rank-adjacent* points into a shared column or row, never from reordering. Bands used: col 33 = Bukit Panjang/Beauty World/Haw Par Villa/Woodlands North/Woodlands/Buona Vista/Botanic Gardens (the whole west-central spine: DTL NW branch + TEL Woodlands + CCL west); col 44 = Orchard/Mayflower/Newton/Outram Park (NSL+TEL central); col 47 = Tanjong Pagar/52/Clarke Quay/57/Dhoby Ghaut; col 52 = Marina Bay/53/Raffles Place/City Hall/51/Bugis/55 as one unbroken NSL-EWL spine giving 6 verticals; col 60 = Paya Lebar/MacPherson/Serangoon; col 68 = Tanjong Katong/Bayshore/Buangkok/Punggol Coast/Bedok North; col 73 = Tanah Merah/Tampines/Pasir Ris. Rows: row 0 = HarbourFront/Marina Bay/Marina South Pier; row 8 = Outram Park/Maxwell/52/50/53/Bayfront/Haw Par Villa, a 5-segment horizontal chain along the EWL+TEL waterfront; row 17 = Fort Canning/57/City Hall/Promenade; row 27 = Buona Vista/Napier/Orchard/Little India/55; row 32 = Botanic Gardens/Stevens/Newton/Paya Lebar/Bayshore; row 38 = Tuas Link/Pioneer/Jurong East/Caldecott/MacPherson/Bedok North/Tanah Merah/Expo; row 46 = Marymount/Bishan/Serangoon. (3) Every merge was checked so no shared line ever runs over a third vertex sitting on it — that is why Marymount/Caldecott sit at col 45 rather than joining col 44 (a col-44 Mayflower-Caldecott vertical would have run straight through Marymount), and why Changi Airport stays off Expo's column (Tampines East is between them). Result: hv 0 -> 50 of 87 and meanDrift 232 -> 97, with cross / vtxOn / collide / orderFlip all held at the control's 0.

Round 2 targets the one place round 1 left slack: the eight unnamed crossing nodes in the CBD, where six lines interleave inside 4% of the map's width. Round 1 had parked City Hall, Raffles Place, 51, 53, 55, Marina Bay and Bugis in a single column 52 spine. That spine blocked the row-17 band, because making 54 share City Hall's row forces 51 onto row 17 too (monotonicity: gy 841/839/828 for 57/51/54 must map to non-decreasing rows), and 51 was in City Hall's column -> collision. So I moved City Hall and Raffles Place one column west to 51 (legal: gx 611/614 sit between 50's 605 and 51/53/55's 616), freeing column 52 for 51 alone. That converted row 17 into a four-station horizontal band Fort Canning-57-54-City Hall-51-Promenade, buying [54,57], [6,54] and [51,39] at the cost of only [15,53]. Dhoby Ghaut and 56 then dropped to row 19 together for [31,56]. Finally 50 moved from column 50 to 51 to sit directly under Raffles Place, making [50,15] vertical while leaving the row-8 waterfront chain 52-50-53-Bayfront intact. I also re-checked the round-1 attempt that put 51 on row 19 while 54 sat on row 17: that scored hv 53 as well but cost orderFlip 1, because it inverts the true north-south order of 51 and 54. Rejected -- criterion 1 outranks hv. This version reaches the same hv 53 with orderFlip still 0. The 34 remaining non-H/V segments are the ones that cannot be aligned without either inverting a geographic order or running a line straight through a third station: the Outram Park fan (deg 6), the Woodlands/Yew Tee/Canberra dogleg, and the Caldecott-Botanic-Stevens triangle. Final: hv 0 -> 53 of 87, meanDrift 232 -> 95, and cross / vtxOn / collide / orderFlip all still 0.
